Replaces the integrated-dataset comparison in `Fig4.effect-size-comparison-flu-sc2glu.Rmd`
(merged fluconazole vs YPD.1 and integrated sc2glu). Here each fluconazole dose is its own
dataset. Baselines: both YPD replicates (YPD.1, YPD.2) and the better SC-2% glucose replicate,
sc2glu.2:

| Comparison | Condition 1 (significant eQTLs) | Condition 2 (lookup) |
|---|---|---|
| YPD.1 vs Flu.1 | Flu.1 (16 ug/ml) | YPD.1 |
| YPD.1 vs Flu.2 | Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) | YPD.1 |
| YPD.2 vs Flu.1 | Flu.1 (16 ug/ml) | YPD.2 |
| YPD.2 vs Flu.2 | Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) | YPD.2 |
| sc2glu.2 vs Flu.1 | Flu.1 (16 ug/ml) | sc2glu.2 |
| sc2glu.2 vs Flu.2 | Flu.2 (8 ug/ml) | sc2glu.2 |

**Direction.** As in the integrated version, the starting set is the fluconazole dataset: every
variant-gene pair that is a significant eQTL in Flu.1 (or Flu.2) is looked up among *all tested*
variants of the baseline (`first_assoc` files) for the same gene. The pair does not have to be
significant in the baseline; the baseline only provides its effect size. So the question is
"do fluconazole eQTLs have the same effect in the baseline?", not "are baseline eQTLs
also found in fluconazole" (that reverse direction is in `concordance_all_pairs.rds` as
"YPD.1 vs Flu.1_16ug" etc.).
In the plots the baseline effect size is on the x axis and the fluconazole effect size on the y
axis. Every statistic is computed for each variant type separately (SNPs, InDels, SVs, CNVs)
and for all variants pooled.

The variant-gene lookups are read from `replicates_concordance/concordance_all_pairs.rds`,
written by `Fig4.effect-size-comparison-replicates.Rmd` (all six datasets, including YPD.2; same
genotype files and FaST-LMM settings as YPD.1). Knit that Rmd first.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
source("/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all/Agrawal_single_cell_eqtl_cell_cycle/shared_code/arial_font.R")  # Arial for all plots, as in Figs 2 and 5
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)

select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
```

# 1. Inputs

```{r config}
ROOT <- "/projects/rps/cgsb/gresham/Akriti/wildyeast1/common_analysis_for_all"
CONC_RDS   <- "../results/replicates_concordance/concordance_all_pairs.rds"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "../results/effect_size_flu_doses_vs_baselines"
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

VARIANTS <- c("SNPs", "InDels", "SVs", "CNVs")
N_PERMS  <- 5000
set.seed(42)

# significant eQTLs of each fluconazole dose (totals per variant type, for "% found")
signif_files <- function(res, tag) {
  res <- file.path(ROOT, res)
  c(SNPs   = file.path(res, paste0("all_signif_SNPs_", tag, "_96_MAF15_from_969_strains_with_double_id_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_with_threshold.txt")),
    InDels = file.path(res, paste0("all_signif_Indels_", tag, "_96_MAF15_with_double_id_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_with_threshold.txt")),
    SVs    = file.path(res, paste0("all_signif_SVs_", tag, "_with_double_id_is_not_needed_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_run_from_new_plink_files_with_threshold.txt")),
    CNVs   = file.path(res, paste0("all_signif_CNV_", tag, "_with_double_id_is_not_needed_final_filtered_for_ncount_less_than_5_run_from_new_plink_files_no_chr17_with_threshold.txt")))
}
SIGNIF <- list(Flu.1_16ug = signif_files("Flu.1/fastlmm/results", "Flu.1"),
               Flu.2_8ug  = signif_files("Flu.2/fastlmm/results", "Flu.2"))

# the six comparisons: key in concordance_all_pairs.rds -> labels
COMP <- tribble(
  ~key,                     ~comparison,          ~flu,         ~flu_lab,            ~base,      ~base_lab,
  "Flu.1_16ug vs YPD.1",    "YPD.1 vs Flu.1",     "Flu.1_16ug", "Flu.1 (16 ug/ml)",  "YPD.1",    "YPD.1",
  "Flu.2_8ug vs YPD.1",     "YPD.1 vs Flu.2",     "Flu.2_8ug",  "Flu.2 (8 ug/ml)",   "YPD.1",    "YPD.1",
  "Flu.1_16ug vs YPD.2",    "YPD.2 vs Flu.1",     "Flu.1_16ug", "Flu.1 (16 ug/ml)",  "YPD.2",    "YPD.2",
  "Flu.2_8ug vs YPD.2",     "YPD.2 vs Flu.2",     "Flu.2_8ug",  "Flu.2 (8 ug/ml)",   "YPD.2",    "YPD.2",
  "Flu.1_16ug vs sc2glu.2", "sc2glu.2 vs Flu.1",  "Flu.1_16ug", "Flu.1 (16 ug/ml)",  "sc2glu.2", "SC2Glu.2",
  "Flu.2_8ug vs sc2glu.2",  "sc2glu.2 vs Flu.2",  "Flu.2_8ug",  "Flu.2 (8 ug/ml)",   "sc2glu.2", "SC2Glu.2")
COMP_LEVELS <- COMP$comparison

missing <- c(CONC_RDS, unlist(SIGNIF)); missing <- missing[!file.exists(missing)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing inputs:\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))

conc_all <- readRDS(CONC_RDS)
stopifnot(all(COMP$key %in% names(conc_all)))

conc <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(COMP)), function(i)
  conc_all[[COMP$key[i]]] %>% mutate(comparison = COMP$comparison[i]))) %>%
  left_join(COMP %>% select(comparison, flu, flu_lab, base_lab), by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(comparison   = factor(comparison, levels = COMP_LEVELS),
         Variant_Type = factor(Variant_Type, levels = VARIANTS),
         # x = baseline, y = fluconazole
         Beta_Base = Beta_Cond2, Beta_Flu = Beta_Cond1,
         direction = ifelse(sign(Beta_Base) == sign(Beta_Flu), "Concordant", "Discordant"))

# significant eQTLs per dose and variant type (unique gene x variant pairs, as in the lookup)
signif_totals <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SIGNIF), function(fk) bind_rows(lapply(VARIANTS, function(vt)
  fread(SIGNIF[[fk]][[vt]], sep = "\t", quote = "", select = c("Source_Phenotype", "SNP")) %>%
    distinct() %>% summarise(n_signif = n()) %>% mutate(flu = fk, Variant_Type = vt)))))

conc %>% count(comparison, Variant_Type) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Variant_Type, values_from = n)
```

# 2. Concordance statistics per variant type

For each comparison and variant type: fraction of fluconazole eQTLs found among the baseline's
tested variants, sign concordance with a one-sided binomial test against 50%, Pearson r and
Spearman rho of the effect sizes, and a permutation test for each (baseline effect sizes
shuffled across eQTLs, `r N_PERMS` permutations). P-values are BH-adjusted over the 24
comparison x variant-type tests (pooled "All variants" rows are adjusted separately).

```{r stats}
conc_stats <- function(d, n_signif) {
  n  <- nrow(d)
  if (n < 3) return(tibble(n_signif = n_signif, n_found = n))
  same  <- sign(d$Beta_Base) == sign(d$Beta_Flu)
  r     <- cor(d$Beta_Base, d$Beta_Flu, method = "pearson")
  rho   <- cor(d$Beta_Base, d$Beta_Flu, method = "spearman")
  perm  <- replicate(N_PERMS, {
    b <- sample(d$Beta_Base)
    c(sign = mean(sign(b) == sign(d$Beta_Flu)), r = cor(b, d$Beta_Flu))
  })
  tibble(n_signif = n_signif, n_found = n, pct_found = 100 * n / n_signif,
         n_concordant = sum(same), pct_concordant = 100 * mean(same),
         binom_p = binom.test(sum(same), n, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
         perm_p_sign = (sum(perm["sign", ] >= mean(same)) + 1) / (N_PERMS + 1),
         pearson_r = r, spearman_rho = rho,
         pearson_p = cor.test(d$Beta_Base, d$Beta_Flu, method = "pearson")$p.value,
         perm_p_r = (sum(perm["r", ] >= r) + 1) / (N_PERMS + 1),
         perm_sign = list(perm["sign", ]), perm_r = list(perm["r", ]))
}

stats_vt <- conc %>% group_by(comparison, flu, Variant_Type) %>%
  group_modify(~ conc_stats(.x, signif_totals$n_signif[signif_totals$flu == .y$flu &
                                                       signif_totals$Variant_Type == .y$Variant_Type])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(binom_p_BH = p.adjust(binom_p, "BH"), pearson_p_BH = p.adjust(pearson_p, "BH"))

stats_all <- conc %>% group_by(comparison, flu) %>%
  group_modify(~ conc_stats(.x, sum(signif_totals$n_signif[signif_totals$flu == .y$flu]))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% mutate(Variant_Type = "All variants",
                       binom_p_BH = p.adjust(binom_p, "BH"), pearson_p_BH = p.adjust(pearson_p, "BH"))

stats_table <- bind_rows(stats_vt %>% mutate(Variant_Type = as.character(Variant_Type)), stats_all) %>%
  mutate(Variant_Type = factor(Variant_Type, levels = c(VARIANTS, "All variants"))) %>%
  arrange(comparison, Variant_Type)

out_table <- stats_table %>% select(-flu, -perm_sign, -perm_r)
write.csv(out_table, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Effect_size_concordance_by_variant_type.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(out_table %>% select(comparison, Variant_Type, n_signif, n_found, pct_found,
                                  pct_concordant, binom_p_BH, pearson_r, spearman_rho, perm_p_r),
             digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 4),
             caption = "Effect-size concordance, fluconazole eQTLs looked up in the baseline")
```

# 3. Scatter plots by variant type

One panel per comparison (rows) and variant type (columns). Points: concordant (same sign)
or discordant; solid line: least-squares fit; dashed line: 1:1.

```{r scatter-fns}
DIR_COLS <- c(Concordant = "#27AE60", Discordant = "#E74C3C")
VT_COLS  <- c(SNPs = "#3498DB", InDels = "#9B59B6", SVs = "#B7950B", CNVs = "#E67E22")
lim <- max(abs(c(conc$Beta_Base, conc$Beta_Flu)), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

panel_lab <- function(st) st %>%
  filter(!is.na(pearson_r)) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("n = %d\nr = %.2f, rho = %.2f\nsame sign = %.0f%%",
                         n_found, pearson_r, spearman_rho, pct_concordant))

scatter_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

plot_scatter <- function(d, st, x_lab, y_lab, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, facet = ~ Variant_Type, ...) {
  ggplot(d, aes(Beta_Base, Beta_Flu)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = direction), size = 1.3, alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_label(data = panel_lab(st), aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1.05, size = 3.1, fontface = "bold",
               label.size = 0, fill = alpha("white", 0.8)) +
    facet_wrap(facet, ...) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DIR_COLS, name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    scatter_theme +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"))
}
```

```{r scatter-grid, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 23}
p_grid <- plot_scatter(conc, stats_vt,
                       x_lab = expression(bold("Effect size "*beta*", baseline (YPD.1, YPD.2 or SC2Glu.2)")),
                       y_lab = expression(bold("Effect size "*beta*", fluconazole")),
                       title = "Effect-size concordance of fluconazole eQTLs, by variant type",
                       subtitle = "Significant eQTLs of the fluconazole dose, looked up among all tested variants of the baseline",
                       facet = comparison ~ Variant_Type) +
  facet_grid(comparison ~ Variant_Type)
print(p_grid)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Fig_effect_size_by_variant_type_all_comparisons.tiff"), p_grid,
       width = 15, height = 23, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
```

```{r scatter-per-comparison, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10, results = "asis"}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(COMP))) {
  cm <- COMP$comparison[i]
  cat("\n\n## ", cm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  p <- plot_scatter(conc %>% filter(comparison == cm), stats_vt %>% filter(comparison == cm),
                    x_lab = bquote(bold("Effect size "*beta*", "*.(COMP$base_lab[i]))),
                    y_lab = bquote(bold("Effect size "*beta*", "*.(COMP$flu_lab[i]))),
                    title = cm, ncol = 2)
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("Fig_effect_size_by_variant_type_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cm), ".tiff")),
         p, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
}
```

# 4. Summary across variant types

```{r summary-plot, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5.5}
sum_long <- stats_table %>%
  select(comparison, Variant_Type, `Sign concordance (%)` = pct_concordant,
         `Pearson r` = pearson_r, `Found in baseline (%)` = pct_found) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(comparison, Variant_Type), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Found in baseline (%)", "Sign concordance (%)", "Pearson r")))

COMP_COLS <- setNames(c("#81C784", "#2E7D32", "#64B5F6", "#1565C0", "#FFB74D", "#E65100"), COMP_LEVELS)
p_sum <- ggplot(sum_long, aes(Variant_Type, value, fill = comparison)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.85), width = 0.8, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(metric == "Pearson r", sprintf("%.2f", value), sprintf("%.0f", value))),
            position = position_dodge(0.85), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COMP_COLS, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Concordance of fluconazole eQTL effect sizes with the baselines") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
print(p_sum)
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Fig_concordance_summary_by_variant_type.tiff"), p_sum,
       width = 14, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
```

# 5. One combined figure per comparison

All variant types in one panel, one figure per comparison. Points: each fluconazole eQTL,
coloured by whether its effect has the same sign in the baseline (concordant) or the opposite
sign (discordant). Lines: least-squares fit per variant type; the legend gives each variant
type's Pearson r and % same direction. Dashed line: 1:1.

**What the numbers mean.** Each point is one variant-gene pair with two signed effect sizes
(beta): baseline on x, fluconazole on y.

- *Same direction (%)*: fraction of eQTLs whose beta has the same sign in both conditions.
  Direction only; magnitude is ignored.
- *Pearson r*: correlation of the signed betas. High r means eQTLs with a larger (or more
  negative) effect in the baseline also have a larger (or more negative) effect in fluconazole,
  i.e. the eQTLs keep their direction **and** their relative size. It does not test whether
  the betas are equal: r = 1 also when every fluconazole effect is twice the baseline effect.
- *Spearman rho*: the same on ranks, so less driven by the few largest effects.
- Whether the magnitudes are equal is shown by the points against the dashed 1:1 line. It is
  not a good test here: only eQTLs significant in fluconazole are plotted, so their fluconazole
  |beta| is always large (>= ~0.4) and sits above the line (selection effect). Absolute effect
  sizes |beta| per condition are compared in `Fig4.PartII-compare-conditions-best-replicates.Rmd`.

```{r pooled-scatter, fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 7, results = "asis"}
pooled_plot <- function(i) {
  cm <- COMP$comparison[i]
  d  <- conc %>% filter(comparison == cm)
  st <- stats_all %>% filter(comparison == cm)
  vt <- stats_vt %>% filter(comparison == cm)
  vt_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n = %d, r = %.2f, %.0f%% same dir.)", vt$Variant_Type, vt$n_found,
                             vt$pearson_r, vt$pct_concordant), as.character(vt$Variant_Type))
  ggplot(d, aes(Beta_Base, Beta_Flu)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = direction), size = 1.4, alpha = 0.35) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = DIR_COLS, name = "Direction", labels = c(
      Concordant = "Same direction", Discordant = "Opposite direction")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
    geom_smooth(aes(colour = Variant_Type), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = VT_COLS, labels = vt_lab, name = "Variant type (fit)") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
    annotate("label", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1.05, size = 4, fontface = "bold",
             label.size = 0, fill = alpha("white", 0.85),
             label = sprintf("All variants, n = %d\nSame direction = %.1f%%\nPearson r = %.2f\nSpearman rho = %.2f",
                             st$n_found, st$pct_concordant, st$pearson_r, st$spearman_rho)) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim)) +
    labs(title = cm,
         subtitle = sprintf("Significant %s eQTLs, effect size looked up in %s", COMP$flu_lab[i], COMP$base_lab[i]),
         x = bquote(bold("Effect size "*beta*", "*.(COMP$base_lab[i]))),
         y = bquote(bold("Effect size "*beta*", "*.(COMP$flu_lab[i])))) +
    scatter_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "right", plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14), axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(COMP))) {
  cm <- COMP$comparison[i]
  cat("\n\n## ", cm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  p <- pooled_plot(i); print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("Fig_effect_size_concordance_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cm), ".tiff")),
         p, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
}
```

# 6. Permutation null distributions (all variants pooled)

```{r null-plots, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4.5, results = "asis"}
null_plot <- function(st) {
  pd <- tibble(sign = st$perm_sign[[1]], r = st$perm_r[[1]])
  a <- ggplot(pd, aes(sign)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "grey70", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = st$pct_concordant / 100, colour = "#E74C3C", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", label.size = 0,
             label = sprintf("Observed = %.3f\npermutation p = %.1e", st$pct_concordant / 100, st$perm_p_sign)) +
    labs(title = "Sign concordance", x = "Sign concordance (permuted)", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  b <- ggplot(pd, aes(r)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "grey70", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = st$pearson_r, colour = "#27AE60", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", label.size = 0,
             label = sprintf("Observed = %.3f\npermutation p = %.1e", st$pearson_r, st$perm_p_r)) +
    labs(title = "Pearson r", x = "Pearson r (permuted)", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  (a | b) + plot_annotation(title = as.character(st$comparison),
                            theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)))
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(stats_all))) {
  cm <- as.character(stats_all$comparison[i])
  cat("\n\n## ", cm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  p <- null_plot(stats_all[i, ]); print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("Fig_null_distribution_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", cm), ".tiff")),
         p, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
}
```
